context_boundary: Segments shorter than context are end-replication padded with recorded masks/lengths, then outputs cropped to every native timestamp; no segment discarded. Context100 preserves TAB wrapper's extra-patch padding policy; context512 uses minimal patch completion.
repeat_boundary: Frozen pretrained zero-shot inference, dropout off and explicit all-observed reconstruction mask. One run per exact checkpoint/context/dataset; no pseudo-independent random-seed repetitions. Entity/time-block bootstrap intervals are retained.
boundary: Actual current official release checkpoint zero-shot reconstruction, not random T5/ICM and not proof of original historical-paper weight equivalence. Full grouped native timestamp coverage, frozen context and validation-only primary threshold. Industrial preprocessing boundaries are retained, including PRONTO label-assisted normal selection. Original-paper fine-tuning, historical checkpoints and complete TAB harness remain separate unfinished obligations.
